citations.long: Not all adverse drug experiences that are both serious and unexpected have been reported to FDA within 15 calendar days of initial receipt of the information.

citations.short: Late submission of quarterly safety reports
citations.long: Not all quarterly periodic adverse drug experience reports have been submitted within 30 days of the close of the quarter.

citations.short: Procedures not  in writing, fully followed
citations.long: The responsibilities and procedures applicable to the quality control unit are not in writing.
Equipment for adequate control over temperature is not provided when appropriate for the manufacture, processing, packing or holding of a drug product.
Written production and process control procedures are not followed in the execution of production and process control functions.
Procedures designed to prevent microbiological contamination of drug products purporting to be sterile are not written.

citations.short: Annual visual exams of drug products
citations.long: Reserve samples from representative sample lots or batches of drug products selected by acceptable statistical procedures are not examined visually at least once a year for evidence of deterioration.
There is a failure to thoroughly review any unexplained discrepancy whether or not the batch has been already distributed.

citations.short: Procedures to be written and followed
citations.long: Procedures describing the handling of all written and oral complaints regarding a drug product are not established and written.

citations.short: Procedures not  in writing, fully followed
citations.long: The responsibilities and procedures applicable to the quality control unit are not in writing.
GMP training is not conducted on a continuing basis to assure that employees remain familiar with CGMP requirements applicable to them.

citations.short: Sanitation--buildings not clean, free of infestation
citations.long: Buildings used in the manufacture, processing, packing or holding of drug products are not free of infestation by rodents, birds insects, and other vermin.
Each lot of components was not appropriately identified as to its status in terms of being quarantined, approved or rejected.

Certificates of testing of containers are accepted in lieu of testing without establishing the reliability of the supplier's test results through appropriate validation of the test results at appropriate intervals.

There are no written procedures for production and process controls designed to assure that the drug products have the identity, strength, quality, and purity they purport or are represented to possess.

citations.short: Actual vs. theoretical yields not determined
citations.long: Actual yield and percentages of theoretical yield are not determined at the conclusion of each appropriate phase of manufacturing of the drug product.
Procedures designed to prevent microbiological contamination of drug products purporting to be sterile are not written.
Written procedures for the receipt, identification, storage, and handling of packaging and labeling materials are not followed.

citations.short: Destruction of excess labels with lot numbers
citations.long: Excess labeling bearing lot or control numbers is not destroyed.
Drug products do not bear an expiration date determined by appropriate stability data to assure they meet applicable standards of identity, strength, quality and purity at the time of use.
The batch production and control records are deficient in that they are not an accurate reproduction of the appropriate master production or control record.
